title: Portal Gun VR
features:
(Oculus Quest or other supported VR headset required for VR experience and the game must also support VR especially with hand tracking support! Script also optionally PC supported)

A portal gun from the valve series, Portal! 

Oculus Controls:
Right Trigger: Blue Portal
B: Orange Portal
Y: Pick up unanchored parts
X: Clear Portals
Left Trigger: Flashlight

Standard Portal Gun version with only PC keybinds can be found here:
https://scriptblox.com/script/Universal-Script-Portal-Gun-6904
script:
--Script by randomsuki
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/randomguy194/dollar-tree-portal-gun/refs/heads/main/Budget%20Portal%20Gun%202.0%20(VR).txt'))()
